name: Louvre Museum Guided Highlights Tour
description: A docent-led tour through the world's largest art museum, covering the Mona Lisa, Winged Victory, and other icons.

name: Seine River Evening Cruise
description: A boat cruise along the Seine past Notre-Dame, the Eiffel Tower, and other landmarks, especially scenic at sunset.

name: Montmartre Walking Tour
description: A self-guided walk through the hilltop artists' quarter, past Sacré-Cœur Basilica and cobblestone streets.

name: Luxembourg Gardens Stroll
description: A landscaped park with fountains, tree-lined paths, and a palace, popular for a relaxed afternoon walk.

name: Moulin Rouge Cabaret Show
description: An evening cabaret performance at the historic Montmartre venue famous for its can-can shows.
